values.name: Postcode directory
values.description: [3251] Code defining postal zones or addresses.

values.name: Bank identification
values.description: Code for identification of banks.

values.name: Railway locations
values.description: Code identifying a location in railway environment.

values.name: Clearing House Interbank Payment System Participants ID
values.description: Participants identification of the automated clearing house of the New York Clearing House Association (CHIPS).

values.name: Clearing House Interbank Payment System Universal ID
values.description: Universal identification of the automated clearing house of the New York Clearing House Association (CHAPS).

values.name: Value added tax identification
values.description: Value added tax identification code.

values.name: Passport number
values.description: Number assigned to a passport.

values.name: Statistical object
values.description: A statistical object such as a statistical concept, array structure component or statistical nomenclature.

values.name: Quality conformance
values.description: A code list specifying the quality standard a product complies with, e.g. ISO9000, BS5750, etc.

values.name: Safety regulation
values.description: A code list specifying the safety regulations which apply to a product, such as UK COSHH (control of substances hazardous to health) regulations.

values.name: Product code
values.description: Code assigned to a specific product by a controlling agency.

values.name: Business account number
values.description: An identifying number or code assigned by issuing authorities to manage business activities.

values.name: Railway services harmonized code
values.description: Services provided by the different railway organizations.

values.name: Type of financial account
values.description: Identification of the type of financial account.

values.name: Type of assets and liabilities
values.description: Identification of the type of assets and liabilities.

values.name: Requirements indicator
values.description: A code list which specifies various requirements that a customer may have when fulfilling a purchase order.

values.name: Handling action
values.description: Codes for handling action.

values.name: Freight forwarder
values.description: Codes for freight forwarders.

values.name: Shipping agent
values.description: Codes for shipping agents.

values.name: Type of package
values.description: Indication of the type of package codes.

values.name: Type of industrial activity
values.description: Identification of the type of industrial activity.

values.name: Type of survey question
values.description: Identification of the type of survey question.

values.name: Customs inspection type
values.description: A code to indicate the type of inspection performed by customs.

values.name: Nature of transaction
values.description: Identification of the nature of the transaction.

values.name: Customs area of transaction
values.description: Customs code to indicate the different types of declarations according to the countries involved in the transaction (e.g. box 1/1 of SAD: inter EC Member States, EC-EFTA, EC-third countries, etc.).

values.name: Customs declaration type
values.description: Customs code to indicate the type of declaration according to the different Customs procedures requested (e.g.: import, export, transit).

values.name: Incoterms 1980
values.description: (4110) Code to indicate applicable Incoterm (1980 edition) under which seller undertakes to deliver merchandise to buyer (ICC). Incoterms 1990: use 4053 only.

values.name: Excise duty
values.description: Customs or fiscal authorities code to identify a specific or ad valorem levy on a specific commodity, applied either domestically or at time of importation.

values.name: Customs indicator
values.description: Customs code for circumstances where only an indication is needed.

values.name: Customs special codes
values.description: Customs code to indicate an exemption to a regulation or a special Customs treatment.

values.name: Statistical nature of transaction
values.description: Indication of the type of contract under which goods are supplied.

values.name: Customs office
values.description: Customs administrative unit competent for the performance of Customs formalities, and the premises or other areas approved for the purpose by the competent authorities (CCC).

values.name: Railcar letter marking
values.description: Codes for all marking codes (in letters) for railcars specifying the type, series, order number, check digit and some technical characteristics.

values.name: Examination facility
values.description: Building or location where merchandise is examined by Customs.

values.name: Customs preference
values.description: Customs code to identify a specific tariff preference.

values.name: Customs procedure
values.description: (9380) Customs code to identify goods which are subject to Customs control (e.g. home use, Customs warehousing, temporary admission, Customs transit).

values.name: Government agency procedure
values.description: Treatment applied by a government agency other than Customs to merchandise under their control.

values.name: Customs simplified procedure
values.description: Customs code to indicate the type of simplified Customs procedure requested by a declarant (CCC).

values.name: Customs status of goods
values.description: Customs code to specify the status accorded by Customs to a consignment e.g. release without further formality, present supporting documents for inspection, etc (CCC).

values.name: Shipment description
values.description: Code to indicate whether a shipment is a total, part or split consignment.

values.name: Commodity
values.description: (7357) Code identifying types of goods for Customs, transport or statistical purposes (generic term).

values.name: Entitlement
values.description: Code to indicate the recipient of a charge amount (IATA).

values.name: Customs transit guarantee
values.description: Customs code to identify the type of guarantee used in a transit movement.

values.name: Accounting information identifier
values.description: Identification of a specific kind of accounting information.

values.name: Customs valuation method
values.description: Customs code to identify the valuation method used to determine the dutiable value of the declared goods.

values.name: Service
values.description: Identification of services.

values.name: Customs warehouse
values.description: Identification and/or location of the Customs warehouse in which goods will be or have been deposited (CCC).

values.name: Special handling
values.description: Code to indicate that the nature of the consignment may necessitate use of special handling procedures (IATA).

values.name: Free zone
values.description: Code identifying the zone within a state where any goods introduced are generally regarded, insofar as import duties and taxes are concerned, as being outside the Customs territory and are not subject to the usual Customs control.

values.name: Charge
values.description: Identification of a type of charge.

values.name: Financial regime
values.description: Nature and methods of a transaction from financial viewpoint.

values.name: Duty, tax or fee payment method
values.description: [4390] Method by which a duty or tax is paid to the relevant administration.

values.name: Rate class
values.description: Code to identify a specific rate category.

values.name: Restrictions/prohibitions on re-use of certain wagons
Port
values.description: A location having facilities for means of transport to load or discharge cargo.

values.name: Area
values.description: Codes for specific geographic areas e.g. seas, straits, basins etc.

values.name: Removable accessories and special equipment on railcars
Airport/city
values.description: As described and published by IATA.

values.name: Means of transport identification
values.description: Code identifying the name or number of a means of transport (vessel, vehicle).

values.name: Document requested by Customs
values.description: Customs code to identify documents requested by Customs in an information interchange.

values.name: Customs release notification
values.description: Authorisation given by Customs to move the goods or not move the goods from the place of registration.

values.name: Customs transit type
values.description: Customs code to indicate the different kinds of transit movement of the goods (e.g. Box 1/3 of the SAD).

values.name: Methods of payment
values.description: Identification of methods of payment.

values.name: Bank branch sorting identification
values.description: Identification of a specific branch of a bank.

values.name: Automated clearing house
values.description: Identification of automated clearing houses.

values.name: Location of goods
values.description: (3384) Indication of the place where goods are located and where they are available for examination.

values.name: Clearing code
values.description: Identification of the responsible bank/clearing house which has cleared or is ordered to do the clearing.

values.name: Terms of delivery
values.description: Code to identify terms of delivery.

values.name: Party identification
values.description: Identification of parties, corporates, etc.

values.name: Goods description
values.description: Identification of a type of goods description.

values.name: Country
values.description: Identification of a country.

values.name: Country sub-entity
values.description: (3228) Identification of country sub-entity (region, department, state, province) defined by appropriate authority.

values.name: Member organizations
values.description: Identification of member organizations.

values.name: Amendment code (Customs)
values.description: Customs code indicating the reason for transmitting an amendment to Customs.

values.name: Social security identification
values.description: Code assigned by the authority competent to issue social security identification to identify a person.

values.name: Tax party identification
values.description: Code assigned by a tax authority to identify a party.

values.name: Rail document names
values.description: Rail specific identifications of documents.

values.name: Harmonized system
values.description: Identification of commodities according to the Harmonized System.

values.name: Export requirements
values.description: Identification of requirements and regulations established by relevant authorities concerning exportation.

values.name: Account analysis codes
values.description: Account service charges list.

values.name: Flow of the goods
values.description: List of statistical codes covering the movement of the goods to be declared (e.g. despatch, arrival).

values.name: Statistical procedures
values.description: Indication of the statistical procedure to which the goods are subject.

values.name: Standard text according US embargo regulations
values.description: US government regulations prescribe specific standard text usage. Using codes from this code list prevents full text transmission.

values.name: Standard text for export according national prescriptions
values.description: National export regulations prescribe specific standard text usage. Using codes from this code list prevents full text transmission.

values.name: Airport terminal
values.description: Code identifying terminals or other sub-locations at airports.

values.name: Activity
values.description: Code identifying activities.

values.name: Combiterms 1990
values.description: Code to indicate the applicable Combiterm (1990 edition), used for the purpose of cost distribution between seller according to Incoterms 1990.

values.name: Dangerous goods packing type
values.description: Identification of package types for the description related to dangerous goods.

values.name: Tax assessment method
values.description: A code to identify the tax assessment method.

values.name: Item type
values.description: A code list defining the level of elaboration of a item such as raw material, component, tooling, etc.

values.name: Product supply condition
values.description: A code list specifying the rules according to which a product is supplied, e.g. from stock, available on demand, make on order, etc.

values.name: Supplier's stock turnover
values.description: A code list giving an indication about the level of the supplier's stock turnover.

values.name: Article status
values.description: A code list defining the status of an article from the procurement point of view, e.g. new article, critical article, etc.

values.name: Quality control code
values.description: A code list specifying how the article is classified according to the quality control point of view, e.g. safety item, subject to regulation, etc.

values.name: Item sourcing category
values.description: A code list to specify details related to the sourcing of the corresponding item such as provided by the buyer, from a mandatory source, etc.

values.name: Dumping or countervailing assessment method
values.description: A code to identify the method used to determine the dumping or countervailing duty.

values.name: Dumping specification
values.description: Code list to identify types of goods for dumping purposes.
